crossRefs.note: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the…
The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.
The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation…
The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son…
the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of…
Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

people.name: Assir
people.line: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath

people.name: Ebiasaph
people.line: Levite descendant of Korah, ancestor of temple gatekeepers

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

translations.web: The sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
translations.bsb: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the clans of the Korahites.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
translations.asv: And the sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
